# Portrait generation

Shared prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create a square painted head-and-shoulders character portrait for an educational tooltip. [Subject below.] Refined realistic editorial oil painting, clear readable facial expression and silhouette at 88 pixels. Face occupies at least half the frame height; entire headwear visible. Ancient Near Eastern setting. Interpretive imaginative likeness. No text, watermark, border, collage, or modern items. Emphasize the specified angle, expression, and distinct colored background.

## isaiah

Isaiah, elderly Judean prophet, long silver beard, lined narrow olive face, off-white hood. LEFT-facing three-quarter profile, eyes lifted toward the sky, brow raised in concern, lips slightly parted. One hand near chest holding edge of a scroll. Eye-level camera. Background: cool storm-blue Judean mountains, shafts of morning light. Silvery blue palette.

## hezekiah

Hezekiah king of Judah, middle-aged Levantine man, short dark beard, rounded olive face, modest thin gold circlet, ochre robe. FRONT-facing symmetrical pose, direct gentle gaze, visibly relieved warm smile. Slightly high camera angle looking down. Background: leafy olive courtyard with warm pale Jerusalem stone, soft green palette.

## sennacherib

Sennacherib king of Assyria, angular mature Mesopotamian face, long squared black curled beard, tall narrow Assyrian royal tiara, red robe. Strong RIGHT-facing near-profile, chin lifted, narrowed stern eyes, brows lowered, proud rigid posture. Low camera angle. Background: deep charcoal palace relief with glowing red torchlight. Black and crimson palette.

## merodach-baladan

Merodach-baladan king of Babylon, older stocky Mesopotamian man with broad lined face, bushy gray beard, low rounded royal cap with a gold band, dark plum robe. Seated leaning forward, head tilted down slightly and turned LEFT, sideways watchful gaze, pursed mouth and one raised eyebrow, thoughtful wary expression. Slightly elevated camera. Background: turquoise river and green reeds in hazy daylight. Teal palette.

## nebuchadnezzar

Nebuchadnezzar II king of Babylon, broad mature Mesopotamian face, square jaw, thick black curled beard, blue and gold Babylonian royal headdress. Shoulders turned LEFT while head looks directly back toward viewer over shoulder, intense furrowed brow and closed firm lips. Low three-quarter camera view. Background: cobalt blue glazed-brick wall with golden lion motif and golden sunlight. Saturated cobalt and gold palette.

## cyrus

Cyrus king of Persia, mature Iranian man, long wavy dark hair, medium beard with a few silver streaks, simple cloth royal headband, ivory and brown Persian robe. Relaxed RIGHT-facing three-quarter pose, head gently tilted, open kind expression with slight confident smile, eyes looking off to distant horizon. Eye-level camera pulled back slightly to include both shoulders. Background: bright rose and apricot dawn over a distant Persian mountain ridge. Airy warm pink and ivory palette.

## Completed profile portrait set (October 2026)

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. Each image uses a polished realistic historical style, a square crop, plausible ancient Near Eastern clothing, and no text or watermark. The prompts deliberately vary the pose, expression, light, and setting.

- **remaliah-v2.png:** Older Israelite nobleman on the left third. He looks past the viewer with concern. Late-afternoon olive grove and hill town.
- **jesse-v2.png:** Older shepherd on the right third. He has a gentle half-smile and holds a staff. Overcast Bethlehem pasture.
- **amoz-v2.png:** Older Judean man in a close, slightly bowed pose. He looks thoughtful. Shaded Jerusalem courtyard with a fig tree.
- **shear-jashub-v2.png:** Young Judean boy in side profile. He looks alert as if listening. Breezy Jerusalem rooftop at dawn.
- **maher-shalal-hash-baz-v2.png:** Young Judean boy kneeling with a clay toy. He has a bright smile. Sunny family courtyard with a pomegranate tree.
- **sargon-ii-v2.png:** Assyrian king in a strong side profile. He has a stern, controlled expression. Shadowed Dur-Sharrukin palace passage.
- **esarhaddon-v2.png:** Assyrian king seated with one hand near his chin. He looks tired and calculating. Lamplit Nineveh council chamber.
- **rabshakeh-v2.png:** Assyrian official shown mid-speech with an open hand. He looks confident and challenging. Windy field camp outside Jerusalem.
- **eliakim-v2.png:** Judean administrator at a palace gate with a ring of keys. He has a focused, welcoming expression. Bright morning light.
- **shebna-v2.png:** Judean scribe seated at a writing desk. He glances sideways with a slight proud smile. Cool records room with scrolls and seals.
- **joah-v2.png:** Judean recorder walking away and looking back. He has a grave expression. Jerusalem wall after rain.
- **nabopolassar-v2.png:** Older Babylonian king in a low-angle view. He looks weary and triumphant. Babylon terrace at blue hour with torchlight and an unfinished gate.
